pulls.purpose: Confirm to Steward that Bills Tracker deleted a business's locally stored bill records
Propose a pay-invoice task for an owner or admin to approve
Link an accepted task proposal to the local bill that created it
Let an owner or admin choose the member who should receive a bill task
Choose the Steward company in which a bill task is created

events.purpose: Delete locally stored bill records when a Steward business is purged
Delete locally stored bill records when an owner disables Bills Tracker with deletion
Record whether Steward created or rejected a proposed bill task
Update the linked bill when its Steward task changes or completes

stores.what: Bills, payment amounts, deadlines, payment status, and Steward task/proposal identifiers entered or created in Steward Bills Tracker

returns.purpose: Pay-invoice tasks for a Steward member, created only after owner or admin approval
